title: [Main] - Bug 656559: Mileage: starting/ending point addresses over 50 characters fail to save on report lines (BC Text[50] limit not enforced)
summary: Address fields in expense-related tables now enforce a 50-character limit to prevent save failures on mileage report lines.
key_points: Extended Expense table address field validation
Prevents addresses over 50 characters from being saved
Aligns with Business Central Text[50] field limits
